regeneration: Python 3.11+, standard library only; versioned snapshot and canonical skill tokens. No training, network, local rehearsal directory, or external dataset required.
artwork: Original passive SVG; original photographs embedded unchanged. Reveals preserve geometry.
specification: Existing IDs, ordered states, citations, provenance and experiment values preserved. Only state.artwork paths were added.

patch_derivation.reference_selection: Actual inspection.load_data converts stored features to float32; inspection.nearest_patch_errors computes the map. The selected cell is an instructional close-up; masks do not enter the calculation.

symbolic_figures: Threshold uses explicitly illustrative 10-defect score positions.
Review shows the specified 24 selections per arm; layout is illustrative, not recorded selection identities.
